name: polynomial_compressor_en12900
title: Positive-displacement compressor with EN12900 efficiency-map polynomials
summary: Translation of the TESPy class PolynomialCompressor: isentropic and volumetric efficiency as 10-coefficient EN12900 polynomials of the evaporation and condensation temperature of a compressor catalogue, heat dissipation ratio, mass flow from swept volume x frequency x eta_v; four operating points (three with a fixed frequency, one with an imposed volumetric flow).

authors: Francesco Witte (TESPy lead developer) and the TESPy contributors
origin.course: TESPy class PolynomialCompressor and its tests/test_components/test_polynomial_compressor.py; Bitzer SP-111-1 map of docs/model_library/heat_pump_partload.ipynb (commit 19425523)

verification.reference: TESPy 0.11.3.dev0 (commit 19425523, CoolProp 8.0.0) run from the local snapshot in a throw-away venv: the class docstring (doctest) cases 1 to 3, tests/test_components/test_polynomial_compressor.py (19 tests pass; catalogue power/cooling tables of the fixtures) and the compressor-map cell of docs/model_library/heat_pump_partload.ipynb (Bitzer SP-111-1 map at 30/50/90 Hz)
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 63 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=1e-06); at rtol=1e-09 three differ with a maximum of 8.7e-09 (T_su[3], an input temperature). Variables not compared: h_2 (virtual adiabatic discharge enthalpy, no TESPy counterpart printed), P_cat/Q_0_cat/P_dev (catalogue polynomials of this model's own data), V_dot_4/T_ev_4/T_cd_ref_4 are compared. Bitzer map: eta_s/eta_v at 2/57 degC reproduced to 3 digits for 30, 50 and 90 Hz. Catalogue fit: the fitted power and cooling polynomials reproduce the 18 catalogue points to 6.4e-04 and 2.3e-04.

related_external: TESPy docs/model_library/heat_pump_partload.ipynb (Bitzer SP-111-1 map and its frequency-dependent subclass, the off-design follow-up of the source component)

history.action: added (T-TRANSLATE of the TESPy PolynomialCompressor, card C-181, inventory row TSP-006)
